data.title: Add change_id field to Bug struct
data.body:
## Summary

Add `change_id` field to Bug struct to track which jj change is working on/completed the bug.

## Implementation

In `src/bug.rs`, add to `Bug`:

```rust
pub struct Bug {
    // ... existing fields ...
    /// The jj change-id currently working on this bug
    pub working_change_id: Option<String>,
    /// The jj change-id that completed this bug
    pub completed_change_id: Option<String>,
}
```

Update `derive_bug()` to populate these from WorkStarted/WorkCompleted events.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] working_change_id field added to Bug
- [ ] completed_change_id field added to Bug
- [ ] derive_bug() populates these from events
- [ ] Backward compatible with existing JSONL files
